[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Elizabeth was born in 1727. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1077|John Glasgow]] and [[Ferguson-15168|Agnes Ferguson]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1077]] is assessed at 94% (proved). Elizabeth’s 25 July 1727 Irvine entry names B Jo Glasgow and Agnes Ferguson; the couple and sibling sequence strongly select the existing John household. Abbreviated father wording, inherited Kilbirnie location and the father’s childhood bridge retain limited doubt.

Father in the Irvine Agnes household; B Jo is retained literally rather than silently expanded into a proved civic title.

Next useful test: Inspect OPR595/1 p39 for B Jo and compare civic records and the 1690 childhood candidate.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3574227&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: Elizabeth Glasgow, 25 Jul 1727, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/3574227].
